question: In Newfoundland and Labrador, my child turns five in December of the upcoming school year. Does being four in September automatically make the child ineligible for kindergarten?
generated_answer: In Newfoundland and Labrador, children are eligible for kindergarten if they are four years of age on or before December 31 of the school year. If your child turns five in December of the upcoming school year, they would be eligible for kindergarten. However, it's essential to note that the specific eligibility criteria may vary depending on the school district or school. It's recommended to contact the local school district or school to confirm the eligibility requirements for kindergarten in your area.
